'''The History and Use of Military Languages''' was an educational course offered to new [[Republic trooper|troopers]] during their training in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Special Forces Division|Special Forces division]] around the time of the [[Great Galactic War]]. The course taught pupils the usage and interpretation of military communication methods, which included combat hand signals created during the [[Jedi Civil War]]. Trooper [[Larin Moxla]] took the class during her training, and used her knowledge of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Civil War combat signals to communicate with the [[J8O soldier droid]] [[Clunker]] several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later<ref name="FA" /> around [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]'' to around [[3643 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The History and Use of Military Languages was mentioned in the [[2010]] novel ''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]'', written by [[Sean Williams]].<ref name="FA" />
